necessary_context.content: Assumption 2.5 requires continuous differentiability and four uniform bounds: theta-gradient variation in theta bounded by L11 times displacement; alpha-gradient variation in alpha by L22; both cross-block variations by L12.
necessary_context.name: Block smoothness

necessary_context.content: Definition 3.1 uses (1/2)||grad h||^2 >= mu(h-h*) for every argument, with h* an attained minimum. Definition 3.2 takes A=R^n and requires -f(theta,.) to be mu-PL for every fixed theta.
necessary_context.name: PL and PL-game conventions

necessary_context.content: Definition A.1 uses h-h* >= (gamma/2)dist(x,argmin h)^2. Lemma A.2 prints gamma=4mu. Lemma A.3 assumes a mu-PL class and closed A(theta)=argmax_alpha f(theta,alpha), and states: for every theta1,theta2 and alpha1 in A(theta1), there exists alpha2 in A(theta2) with ||alpha1-alpha2|| <= L12||theta1-theta2||/(2mu). Lemma A.5 assumes Assumption 2.5 and the PL-game assumption, states the marginal gradient identity, and prints smoothness L11+L12^2/(2mu). These constants are reported faithfully, not endorsed.
